mei: Heads-up — Canary rollout of orpheus-v1-q4f16 is showing a small but consistent translation/regression for mixed Japanese+Arabic inputs. Seen bracket/order flips and punctuation mirroring inside inline Arabic segments. BLEU on hybrid-ja-ar testset dropped from 31.2 -> 24.7; chrF -4.2. Rolling back mitigates, but want triage before we re-enable.

james: Can you paste the exact prompt + model variant + output? I suspect a tokenizer/detok mirror-parens change in the q4 build.

mei: Repro below (canary instance). model=orpheus-v1-q4f16, region=ap-northeast-1, route=canary-orf.
```
input: "今日は(مرحبا) 世界"
expected_en: "Today (مرحبا) world"
actual_en: "Today )مرحبا( world"
```
Small variations also for Hebrew parentheses: opening/closing flipped around Arabic/Hebrew spans.

anita: Interesting. We haven't changed the runtime bidi code recently, but tokenizer pack bumped in the quant build pipeline last week. Could be detok order vs. bidi normalization ordering. @lucas any deployments that bundled a new tokenizer pack with q4 builds? :thinking: 

eval-bot: Automated eval 1789012400: hybrid-ja-ar BLEU=24.7 (baseline 31.2). Regression flagged: severity=high, impacted-samples=124/1k.

lucas: We did include tokenizer-pack 2.1.9 in the q4 build (versus 2.1.7 on baseline). No runtime code changes otherwise. @mei can you repro locally with 2.1.7 vs 2.1.9?

mei: Repro'd locally. Quick repro script below — runs tokenizer.detokenize and the model postprocess pipeline. With pack 2.1.9 detok produces mirrored parentheses inside RTL spans. With 2.1.7 it's fine.
```python
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
for pack in ["2.1.7","2.1.9"]:
    t = Tokenizer(pack=pack)
    toks = t.tokenize("今日は(مرحبا) 世界")
    detok = t.detokenize(toks)
    print(pack, detok)
# expected: 2.1.7 -> "今日は(مرحبا) 世界" ; 2.1.9 -> "今日は)مرحبا( 世界"
```

james: If the tokenizer pack changed a default (e.g., mirror_parens=True vs False), that would explain mirror behavior. We should avoid rolling that into production quant builds until we audit detok. For now, route canary traffic to the float16 variant or older tokenizer pack.

ops-bot: Routing request RR-337 created and applied: canary traffic 5% -> 0% for orpheus-v1-q4f16-canary.

anita: I'll start a bisect between 2.1.7..2.1.9 to find the commit that toggled bidi/mirroring logic. Also will run the hybrid evaluation subset of 2k samples to see scope.

mei: Thanks — I'll hold on re-enabling canary until we have a patch or we pin tokenizer-pack in the quant pipeline. Will post bisect/logs here in ~30m. :thumbsup:
